risk: R5: Sessions and Workspaces share an agents isolate's 128 MB

node.where: Node (V8) with --expose-gc; workerd has no heap API

deployed.workspace: r5-memory (2,000 tracked files of 40 lines each, 40x7 directories, loose objects; made by the Container's git)

steps.step: 20 files appended through the Workspace's files

deployed.memoryErrors: none (no 'exceeded memory' resets; every call answered)

verdict: Within the guard (2,000 tracked files, 16 MB of packs). A capture of the whole 2,000-file working tree peaks at 40–52 MB of heap above the baseline in V8 (68 MB total at worst over two runs) and releases it; diffs and stale status patches peak under 20 MB. Two live Sessions (a pi-durable Harness each, a few MB) and one capture fit in 128 MB with room; two captures at once in one isolate would be near the limit. The guard stays at 2,000; no third Worker (ADR-0014 unchanged).
